title: Color personality test: red, blue, yellow or green? — cv.cm
description: Free color personality test: answer 12 questions to see whether you're mainly red, blue, yellow or green, with your score for each color. No sign-up; answers stay in your browser.
lede: Red and direct, blue and precise, yellow and sunny, or green and calm? Answer 12 questions to find your main color and how much of the other three you have.
about: Color personality tests use four colors as an easy way to talk about behavior. In this one, red stands for drive and directness, blue for logic and care, yellow for energy and optimism, and green for calm and harmony. Each question offers one answer in each color.

This test was written for cv.cm and is just for fun. It has no link to trademarked systems such as Insights Discovery, True Colors or the Color Code, and it doesn't claim that your favorite color says anything about you. The colors are labels for habits. For a test with stronger research behind it, try the Big Five.

faq.q: What do the four colors mean?
faq.a: Red is direct and results-driven, blue is logical and careful, yellow is sociable and optimistic, and green is calm and caring.

faq.q: How is the color worked out?
faq.a: Each question has one answer per color. The color you choose most is your result, and the bars show all four. If colors tie, the page names them all.

faq.q: Is the color personality test scientific?
faq.a: No. It is a simple, memorable way to think about style, not a validated measure. For research-based results, take the Big Five test on this site.

faq.q: Does this test ask about my favorite color?
faq.a: No. Your result comes from how you act in everyday situations, whatever colors you like to wear.

items.q: A group project is starting. You…
options: Take charge and set the deadline
Work out exactly what needs doing
Get everyone excited about the idea

items.q: How do you make a big decision?
options: Think about how it will affect people

items.q: Your friends would describe you as…
options: Kind and easy to be with
Crack a joke to lighten the mood
Try to help everyone feel heard
Ask for the facts before saying anything

items.q: Your desk or room usually looks…
options: Set up for getting things done fast
Neat, with everything in its place
Long stretches with nobody to talk to
Go for the biggest challenge available
Relax and go at everyone's pace

items.q: When someone comes to you with a problem, you…
options: Tell them what to do about it
Help them analyze it step by step
Cheer them up and find the bright side

items.q: What do you most want people to say about your work?
options: It made things easier for everyone

items.q: In a meeting, you are the one who…

options: You find it hard to say no
You can be impatient and blunt

red.name: Red: the driver
red.body: You are direct, confident and focused on results. You act when others hesitate and aren't afraid of a hard call. Slow down now and then to listen: people will follow you more readily if they feel heard.

blue.name: Blue: the analyst
blue.body: You are logical, careful and thorough. You want the facts and do things properly. Remember that not every decision needs perfect information, and that people may need warmth as well as accuracy.

yellow.name: Yellow: the spark
yellow.body: You are sociable, upbeat and full of ideas. You bring energy into a room and get people going. A little structure helps you finish what you start and keep the promises you make so easily.

green.name: Green: the peacemaker
green.body: You are calm, patient and caring. People trust you and feel at ease around you. Speak up about what you want, too: harmony doesn't have to mean always giving way.
